# Ozzy's Equipment Hire

> Melbourne-based VMS sign hire, LED trailer sign hire and LED screen trailer hire across Victoria, Australia.

## Services
- VMS sign hire for traffic management, roadworks and site safety
- LED trailer sign hire Melbourne and trailer LED sign hire for events and campaigns
- LED screen trailer, LED trailer screen hire, mobile LED screen trailer hire Melbourne and mobile trailer LED screen hire Melbourne

## Service area
Melbourne CBD, Greater Melbourne suburbs, Geelong, Ballarat, Bendigo, Gippsland and regional Victoria.
